name: Shielded Souls: Legendary Love
source:
You've always had a strong sense of justice, but you never knew where it came from until a freak landslide sent you to another world—your home world! As you acclimate to this new land, you realize you have the ability to strengthen the powers of others through physical contact, and the more intimate that contact is, the stronger the effect!

Party up with three gorgeous heroines to uncover the truth behind your past and save your home from the wrath of the Demon Lord!
